prompts.title: Email Subject Line Generator
prompts.content: Write 5 compelling email subject lines for [PRODUCT/SERVICE]. The target audience is [TARGET AUDIENCE]. The goal is to [SPECIFIC GOAL like increase open rates, drive sales, etc.]. Make them attention-grabbing but not spammy. Include emojis where appropriate.

prompts.title: Social Media Content Calendar
prompts.content: Create a 30-day social media content calendar for [BUSINESS/BRAND]. Focus on [INDUSTRY/NICHE]. Include post types: educational, promotional, behind-the-scenes, user-generated content, and trending topics. Provide post ideas, optimal posting times, and relevant hashtags for each platform.

prompts.title: Code Documentation Generator
prompts.content:
Generate comprehensive documentation for this [PROGRAMMING LANGUAGE] code:

[INSERT CODE]

Include: function descriptions, parameter explanations, return values, usage examples, and any important notes about implementation or edge cases.

prompts.title: Blog Post Outline Creator
prompts.content:
Create a detailed blog post outline for the topic: '[BLOG TOPIC]'. Target audience: [AUDIENCE]. Word count goal: [WORD COUNT]. Include:
- Compelling headline
- Introduction hook
- 5-7 main sections with subpoints
- Conclusion with call-to-action
- SEO keywords to target

prompts.title: Customer Persona Generator
prompts.content:
Create a detailed customer persona for [PRODUCT/SERVICE]. Include:
- Demographics (age, location, income)
- Psychographics (values, interests, lifestyle)
- Pain points and challenges
- Goals and motivations
- Preferred communication channels
- Buying behavior patterns
- Potential objections

prompts.title: Meeting Summary Template
prompts.content:
Summarize this meeting transcript into a professional format:

[INSERT TRANSCRIPT]

Include:
- Meeting date, attendees, and purpose
- Key decisions made
- Action items with owners and deadlines
- Important discussion points
- Next steps and follow-up requirements

prompts.title: Product Description Writer
prompts.content:
Write a compelling product description for [PRODUCT NAME]. Target audience: [AUDIENCE]. Key features: [LIST FEATURES]. Benefits: [LIST BENEFITS]. Tone: [PROFESSIONAL/CASUAL/LUXURY]. Include:
- Attention-grabbing headline
- Problem-solution approach
- Feature-benefit pairs
- Social proof elements
- Clear call-to-action

prompts.title: Learning Path Designer
prompts.content:
Design a comprehensive learning path for [SKILL/TOPIC]. Learner level: [BEGINNER/INTERMEDIATE/ADVANCED]. Time available: [TIMEFRAME]. Include:
- Prerequisites and starting knowledge
- Sequential learning modules
- Practical exercises and projects
- Resources and tools needed
- Milestones and progress markers
- Assessment methods

prompts.title: Crisis Communication Response
prompts.content:
Draft a crisis communication response for [SITUATION]. Stakeholders: [LIST STAKEHOLDERS]. Key messages to convey:
- Acknowledgment of the situation
- Responsibility and accountability
- Immediate actions being taken
- Prevention measures for the future
- Contact information for further inquiries
Tone: Professional, empathetic, transparent

prompts.title: User Story Generator
prompts.content:
Generate user stories for [FEATURE/PRODUCT]. User types: [LIST USER TYPES]. Format each story as:

'As a [USER TYPE], I want [GOAL] so that [BENEFIT]'

Include:
- Acceptance criteria for each story
- Priority level (High/Medium/Low)
- Estimated effort points
- Dependencies between stories

prompts.title: Competitive Analysis Framework
prompts.content:
Conduct a competitive analysis for [YOUR COMPANY/PRODUCT] against [COMPETITORS]. Analyze:
- Product features and pricing
- Market positioning and messaging
- Strengths and weaknesses
- Customer reviews and feedback
- Marketing strategies and channels
- Opportunities and threats
Provide actionable insights and recommendations.

prompts.title: Interview Question Generator
prompts.content:
Generate interview questions for [JOB POSITION] at [COMPANY TYPE]. Experience level: [JUNIOR/MID/SENIOR]. Include:
- Technical questions specific to the role
- Behavioral questions using STAR method
- Situational problem-solving scenarios
- Cultural fit questions
- Questions about career goals and motivation
Provide sample ideal answers for key questions.

prompts.title: SEO Content Optimizer
prompts.content:
Optimize this content for SEO:

[INSERT CONTENT]

Target keyword: [KEYWORD]
Target audience: [AUDIENCE]

Provide:
- Improved title with keyword
- Meta description (150-160 characters)
- Header structure (H1, H2, H3)
- Keyword density recommendations
- Internal linking suggestions
- Featured snippet optimization tips

prompts.title: Presentation Slide Creator
prompts.content:
Create slide content for a presentation on '[TOPIC]'. Audience: [AUDIENCE]. Duration: [TIME]. Include:
- Compelling title slide
- Agenda/outline slide
- 5-7 main content slides with key points
- Visual suggestions for each slide
- Conclusion slide with next steps
- Q&A preparation notes
Keep text concise and impactful.

prompts.title: A/B Test Hypothesis Creator
prompts.content:
Create an A/B test hypothesis for [WEBSITE ELEMENT/CAMPAIGN]. Current performance: [METRICS]. Goal: [IMPROVEMENT GOAL]. 

Format: 'If we [CHANGE], then [PREDICTED OUTCOME] because [REASONING]'

Include:
- Test variations to try
- Success metrics to measure
- Statistical significance requirements
- Test duration recommendations
- Potential risks and mitigation

prompts.title: Grant Proposal Writer
prompts.content:
Write a grant proposal for [PROJECT/ORGANIZATION]. Grant type: [FOUNDATION/GOVERNMENT/CORPORATE]. Amount requested: [AMOUNT]. Include:
- Executive summary
- Problem statement and need
- Project description and methodology
- Expected outcomes and impact
- Budget breakdown
- Timeline and milestones
- Evaluation methods
- Sustainability plan

prompts.title: API Documentation Generator
prompts.content:
Generate API documentation for this endpoint:

Endpoint: [ENDPOINT URL]
Method: [GET/POST/PUT/DELETE]
Description: [BRIEF DESCRIPTION]

Include:
- Endpoint description and purpose
- Request parameters and types
- Request body examples (JSON)
- Response format and status codes
- Error handling and codes
- Authentication requirements
- Rate limiting information
- Code examples in multiple languages

prompts.title: Event Planning Checklist
prompts.content:
Create a comprehensive event planning checklist for [EVENT TYPE]. Expected attendees: [NUMBER]. Budget: [BUDGET RANGE]. Include:
- Pre-event tasks (8-12 weeks before)
- Mid-planning tasks (4-8 weeks before)
- Final preparations (1-4 weeks before)
- Day-of-event tasks
- Post-event follow-up
- Budget tracking spreadsheet format
- Vendor contact template

prompts.title: Customer Feedback Survey
prompts.content:
Design a customer feedback survey for [PRODUCT/SERVICE]. Survey goals: [SPECIFIC GOALS]. Target response rate: [PERCENTAGE]. Include:
- Introduction explaining survey purpose
- 8-12 strategic questions (mix of multiple choice and open-ended)
- Net Promoter Score (NPS) question
- Customer satisfaction ratings
- Demographic questions (optional)
- Thank you message with incentive
- Survey logic and skip patterns

prompts.title: Risk Assessment Matrix
prompts.content:
Create a risk assessment for [PROJECT/BUSINESS INITIATIVE]. Scope: [DEFINE SCOPE]. Include:
- Risk identification (minimum 10 risks)
- Risk categories (operational, financial, technical, legal)
- Probability assessment (Low/Medium/High)
- Impact assessment (Low/Medium/High)
- Risk score calculation
- Mitigation strategies for high-priority risks
- Contingency plans
- Risk owner assignments
- Review schedule
